name: Methuselah
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: The chapter abbreviates to one named son in each generation for a reason: it is tracing the line of the sons of God, from Seth through Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah.

note.label: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth
